content.comment_body: Hello all, I am working on a machine with a [product_name] [version_no]. While testing, I noticed that when connected online to the [product_name], I am unable to force its inputs or outputs. Is there a way to do this? If so, how can it be done? Thank you.

The [product_name] does not provide a FORCE function. Digital inputs cannot be forced under any circumstance. Digital outputs can only be forced externally (for example, using the web server) but only if they are not being utilized within the control program.
Thank you for your response. I would like to know if it is possible to achieve this using memory bits instead. Thanks again.
Could you clarify what you mean by 'this memory bits'?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are attempting to force digital inputs or outputs during software operation with the [product_name] [version_no], but find there is no built-in force function. The capability to control outputs externally is limited, and inputs cannot be forced. There is interest in using memory bits as an alternative, highlighting a demand for more flexible testing options.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to force digital inputs and outputs directly on the controller for testing via software or another simple method.
